title: Great bike tour with Idalia.
text: We went on the tour with Idalia and she was fabulous, seen all the sights and great food recommendations.
author: Fran_K

title: Great bike tour
text: We had a fabulous e bike tour this morning with the wonderful Idalia, she was so informative and gave us some great tips on places to visit and eat. Would highly recommend.
author: Frankilk

title: PedaOle Seville Cycle Tour
text: Very relaxed, enjoyable cycle tour around the city. The guide was very engaging and accommodating with a good knowledge of all the sights of Seville. Well maintained bikes. Suitable for all ages. Would recommend.
author: A3133CFjudithr

title: Guide, speaks French very well and quality tour
text:
We had an exceptional time, because our guide Sylvie knows her city, her neighborhood, and the history of Seville very well
He is full of information, he speaks French extremely well
You can ask him any questions you want, honestly since we will return to Seville, we will do another tour perhaps longer, because the route is very easy
I recommend it with my eyes closed
And the best for last, because Silvio gives you restaurant addresses, free tours, and spots to discover
author: didierl923

title: Fun experience on e-bikes around Seville
text: Amazing trip with a great guide Idalia who showed us the important areas and gave us great recommendations for cocktails in the Hotel and look at the University
author: paulwrightyboy

title: Superb experience!!
text: An excellent experience, this electric bike tour to discover Seville. Thanks to our guide Silvio for sharing his knowledge of his city as well as valuable tips, all in perfect French 👍
author: 425sybillep

title: Well worth it to hit the highlights
text: Great tour that hits the highlights.  Our guide, Idalia, was informative and fun.
author: BillH676

title: Excellent
text: An excellent trip with a very knowledgeable guide. Very accommodating company with first class communication. We were a group of 12 including 2 children and everyone thoroughly enjoyed the trip vs and we saw so much of Seville that you would not otherwise see
author: mandgh2017

title: From start to finish we were catered for with the upmost hospitality and easy pace of cycling through the city fantastic
text:
Experienced the city as a local with a great guide. 
A must do when visiting Seville to see the highlights of this amazing city.
author: revolverregal

title: cycling in 42 degrees!
text: This tour was great. the electric bikes made cycling effortless in the extreme heat and there was a nice breeze as you cycled.  Cody our guide was very knowledgeable about the city and surrounding area and I'd definitely recommend taking this tour.
author: sam
